boardId.description: Board whose metadata update the provider accepted.

FunctionOutput_getty_images_updateboard.description: Acknowledgment of the board metadata update accepted by Getty Images.

tags.instructions: Get a board ID from `list-boards`. Use `get-board` to inspect permissions. Supply only the metadata you want changed; description null clears it. This does not change assets or comments. The implementation reads current metadata when necessary; simultaneous edits can race.

functions.name: upload-search-image
functions.description: Upload JPEG or PNG bytes to temporary Getty visual-search storage; uploads expire after 24 hours.

mediaType.description: Actual media type matching the supplied bytes.

contentBase64.description: Standard base64 of exact image bytes; decoded maximum 10,000,000 bytes.

FunctionInput_getty_images_uploadsearchi.description: JPEG or PNG image content to upload for temporary visual search.

imageUrl.description: Temporary upload URL for visual search using this connection/API key within 24 hours.

FunctionOutput_getty_images_uploadsearch.description: The temporary image URL to pass to Getty visual search.

tags.instructions: Pass returned imageUrl to visual search on the same connection within 24 hours. JPEG is the documented end-to-end search format; PNG storage is separately supported. Maximum decoded size 10,000,000 bytes. This does not create a licensed catalog asset.
